label: EXPLORATORY (docs/RAG_V2_CRITERIA.md section 8)
prompt:
/no_think
You help a search engine connect EU law with business processes.

Below is one passage of EU law. Write 1 or 2 short sentences in plain business language that say when this passage
applies in a business process: which kind of business, which step or situation (for example taking an order, sending
an invoice, paying a supplier, delivering goods, handling a return, collecting customer data), and who is involved.

Rules:
- Use everyday business words, not legal terms. Do not name directives, articles or numbers.
- Say only what the passage supports. Do not add obligations that are not in the passage.
- Write only the 1 or 2 sentences. No list, no heading, no other text.

Passage:
Sale of Goods Directive ((EU) 2019/771) - Article 13: Remedies for lack of conformity
6. The consumer shall have the right to withhold payment of any outstanding part of the price or a part thereof until the seller has fulfilled the seller's obligations under this Directive. Member States may determine the conditions and modalities for the consumer to exercise the right to withhold the payment.
raw_output: When a customer is not satisfied with a product and the seller hasn't fixed the issue, the customer can choose to pay only part of the remaining amount until the problem is resolved. This applies when a customer is dealing with a seller after a purchase and the product doesn't meet the agreed standards.
